relationship.support_rule: closed contact may either stick and carry tangential support or slide with the same topology; contact alone does not confer static support authority
relationship.force_rule: normal compression earns eligibility for tangential force; rising shear reaches an authored impending-slip gate; slip changes tangential authority without opening contact topology
relationship.topology_rule: TOUCH remains closed through STICK->SLIDE->RESTICK; topology opens only after tangential then normal load return to zero
relationship.release_rule: tangential unload -> normal unload -> zero-load touch -> release gap

keys.name: SEPARATE_READ
keys.causal_role: establish independent ground support and visible wall gap before eligibility
keys.root_com_note: root is stacked over both feet; wall carries nothing

keys.name: ELIGIBILITY_APPROACH
keys.causal_role: commit COM toward wall while preserving a one-cell negative-space gap
keys.root_com_note: COM advances before palm contact; support remains ground-owned

keys.name: TOUCH_ZERO
keys.causal_role: close palm-wall topology at zero load without granting support authority
keys.root_com_note: palm touches wall but root is still carried by ground; no static-friction claim yet

keys.name: NORMAL_PRELOAD
keys.causal_role: compress into wall so tangential support can become eligible after topology is already closed
keys.root_com_note: normal load rises first; shoulder closes toward wall while rear foot counters the normal reaction

keys.name: STICK_LOAD_RISE
keys.causal_role: hold the palm at one wall coordinate while root drops and tangential force visibly carries part of the load
keys.root_com_note: palm remains world-fixed at y=7 while pelvis sinks; diagonal body line and rear-foot edge show wall-assisted support

keys.name: IMPENDING_SLIP
keys.causal_role: reach maximum tangential demand while the contact patch remains fixed and topology unchanged
keys.root_com_note: COM falls farther beneath a still-fixed palm; static support is visibly at its authored limit

keys.name: SLIP_ONSET
keys.causal_role: change tangential authority without opening contact: palm begins moving down the same wall
keys.root_com_note: contact stays closed but hand y changes for first time; static wall support authority is gone and root overruns downward

keys.name: SLIDING_DROP
keys.causal_role: make continuing closed-contact slip unmistakable through hand migration, root drop and trailing free-arm lag
keys.root_com_note: palm slides four rows while root and COM continue down/right; free arm remains high as opposing secondary lag

keys.name: SHEAR_UNLOAD_WHILE_SLIDING
keys.causal_role: reduce tangential demand before restick while contact remains closed and still moving
keys.root_com_note: front foot catches and root begins rising while palm finishes one last downward cell; shear demand falls before restick

keys.name: RESTICK_DISPLACED
keys.causal_role: re-establish static tangential support at the new lower wall coordinate after demand reduction
keys.root_com_note: palm y=13 stays fixed while body rebounds upward/left; new anchor is displaced and visibly earns support

keys.name: TANGENTIAL_UNLOAD_ZERO
keys.causal_role: remove wall shear while maintaining normal closure for one beat
keys.root_com_note: root is restacked by ground before wall release; palm still presses but carries no tangential support

keys.name: NORMAL_UNLOAD_ZERO
keys.causal_role: return normal load to zero while preserving contact topology
keys.root_com_note: both force components are zero while palm still touches; release is now eligible

keys.name: RELEASE_GAP
keys.causal_role: open topology only after both loads are zero
keys.root_com_note: a real horizontal gap opens; torso recoils away while free arm continues upward

keys.name: COUNTER_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: pay stored lean and slide debt with body overshoot opposite the wall while the contact arm trails
keys.root_com_note: root overshoots left; contact arm lags low and free arm stays high, creating split clocks and open negative space

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: settle at a new address without returning to the opening pose
keys.root_com_note: root settles right of the opening address with asymmetric arms and preserved release gap
